verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region or residency is a fair question for a cloud-backed remote-desktop service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, residency options or on-premises hosting. The CLI, REST API and portal docs cover automation, session logs and user management, not where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
